method: Editorial player-facing quality scores, not automated test percentages or percentage of development complete. Equal-weight current-area mean times ten gives the overall index. Target rows are minimum quality floors; overall release threshold is 90+ and zero unresolved P0s, so merely touching every floor is insufficient.

scale.2: small proof or severely incomplete pillar
scale.6: coherent playable system with substantial remaining quality work
